ideas.pitch: A rapid pixel-matching boilerplate and component library tailored for sudden UI recreation challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Beginner Segment – Website Recreation: Participants will recreate a reference website revealed by the organisers at the beginning of the competition.
ideas.title: PrecisionClone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on visual accuracy and CSS layout speed, aligning with the primary grading rubric of the beginner segment.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined diagnostic toolkit for rapidly tracing console errors, broken hooks, and misconfigured backend endpoints.
ideas.problem_statement: Advanced Segment – Debug and Deploy: Participants will receive a pre-written codebase containing bugs, incomplete features, and backend issues.
ideas.title: DebugExpress
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the efficiency required in the debug-and-deploy track by minimizing time spent searching for common state and routing bugs.

ideas.pitch: A micro-state management utility designed to instantly patch broken prop-drilling and unhandled promise rejections in unfamiliar React codebases.
ideas.problem_statement: Advanced Segment – Debug and Deploy: Participants will receive a pre-written codebase containing bugs, incomplete features, and backend issues.
ideas.title: StateDrill
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the most common category of hidden bugs in hackathon starter repos—broken async data flows and rendering loops.

ideas.pitch: A pre-configured CSS Grid and Flexbox layout scaffolding generator optimized for instant responsiveness across device viewports.
ideas.problem_statement: Beginner Segment – Website Recreation: Participants will recreate a reference website revealed by the organisers at the beginning of the competition, focusing on visual accuracy, responsiveness, and functionality.
ideas.title: LayoutGrid Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes score points on responsiveness and visual alignment under extreme time pressure.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mock API wrapper and proxy handler to instantly stabilize missing or failing backend endpoints in incomplete challenge repos.
ideas.problem_statement: Advanced Segment – Debug and Deploy: Participants will receive a pre-written codebase containing bugs, incomplete features, and backend issues.
ideas.title: EndpointPatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures the frontend demo works live even if the original backend code is unfixable within the time limit.
